The video was filmed at a veterinary hospital in Colorado. The man in it is Lt. Daniel Mercer, a 39-year-old Colorado police officer. Across his lap lies Ranger, an 11-year-old black German shepherd who worked alongside him as his K9 partner for nine years.

Ranger had been living with a serious neurological illness for eight months. The veterinarian who cared for the department’s dogs had treated him from the start and talked Daniel through what to expect as his condition worsened.

A month before the appointment, Ranger could no longer make it through his morning walk. Two weeks before, he’d stopped eating regularly. By the final week, he couldn’t get out of bed without help.

Daniel made the appointment on Thursday. When his shift commander found out the next morning, he offered to bring a few officers along to support him. Daniel asked his wife, Claire, to be the only person there with him.

At Daniel’s request, Claire took out her phone to film their last moments together. He wanted to be able to look back on their goodbye and have someone else who could help him tell Ranger’s story.

In the video, Daniel sits in a softly lit room the hospital uses for end-of-life care. A blanket covers part of the floor. Ranger lies across Daniel’s lap with his head tucked against his arm, breathing softly and slowly. During the drive over, he’d barely been able to lift his head.

Dr. Elena Park stepped quietly into the room. Daniel told Ranger he was safe, that he couldn’t have asked for a better partner, and that it was okay to rest now.

What Ranger did next nearly made Claire drop her phone. With visible effort, he lifted his front legs a little at a time until both paws rested on Daniel’s shoulders. Then he held them there.

Daniel went still and bowed his head until it touched Ranger’s. Dr. Park stepped back to give them a moment. The only sound was Daniel’s breathing.

Claire later said Ranger had barely been able to move and had needed help standing for days. She watched him reach all the way up to Daniel’s shoulders and saw Daniel wrap both arms around him.

That was when Claire said she couldn’t film anymore.
